name: peerkit-video-chat
description: Showcase video chat application built on PeerKit
comment:overrides: Pin React Native + React to the Expo SDK 54 versions tree-wide. The mobile native modules (react-native-webrtc/permissions) and the file:-linked RN transport accept newer RN via broad peer ranges, so npm would otherwise hoist a newer react-native than Expo 54 (and its babel/codegen) supports, breaking the metro bundle.
